title: Rock-a-my-Soul
transcription:
Rock-a-my-Soul
Three part round

Rock-a-my soul
in the bosom of Abraham
Rock-a my soul
in the bosom of Abraham
Rock-a my soul
in the bosom of Abraham,
Oh rock-a my soul!

I'm singin'
So high, can't get over it,
so low, can't get under it,
so wide, can't get around it,
Oh rock-a my soul!

I'm singin'
Rock my soul,
Rock my soul,
Rock my soul,
Oh rock-a my soul!

Sing all three verses together, then have three
groups, each starting on a different verse, sing
through all three verses.
notes: Draft song-level split from visual page transcription. Source page note: Draft visual transcription from a clear two-page scan. Several nonsense/phonetic words are uncertain.
